programme.title: Wagon Wheels
programme.desc: Randolph Scott (Ride the High Country) stars as Clint Belmet, the leader of a wagon train on the way to Oregon. Along the route he and his crew deal with various hardships, including Indian attacks and a fellow named Murdock (Monte Blue) who is out to stop them at any cost. With a cast that includes the likes of Gail Patrick and Billy Lee, this adventure saga was based on a novel by the western master, Zane Grey (Riders of the Purple Sage, Fighting Caravans). Trivia note: The film's original title was Caravans West.

programme.title: Under Western Stars
programme.desc: Roy Rogers debuts in his starring role as the likable cowboy sent to Congress with a mission: let Washington know about the suffering of farmers in the wake of America's 1930s Dustbowl. Enjoy the singing cowboy in his first starring role, rubbing shoulder with politians, going up against greedy executives, and representing a whole people group you'll see why Rogers became a national icon! Frog Millhouse: Smiley Burnett. Elanore Fairbanks: Carol Hughes. John Fairbanks: Guy Usher. Plus music and singing from the Maple City Four. (The song Dust was nominated for an Academy Award!) Directed by Joe Kane.

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Red's aunt, the Duchess, knew Steve's father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: John Wayne sings! Well, not really. His voice was dubbed here, but as Singin Sandy Saunders hes still able to write the code of justice with a blazing sixgun! Hes a government agent out to help a group of ranchers in their battle with a villain who is tying up local water rights. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Al St. John, Yakima Canutt, and Cecilia Parker, Riders of Destiny was filmed early in Waynes career it was his first for Lone Star but the unmistakable swagger is already in place!

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Ted Hayden, a tough hombre who goes undercover to join a gang led by a heartless fiend known only as Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock). Gentry is out to take over a ranch belonging to one of Hayden's friends, but as Hayden finds out, Gentry has a lot more than that up his sleeve. You'll have to watch this two-fisted Western to find out the rest!

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: The son of Sheriff Clay Hartley, of the frontier town Elder, has gotten into bad company and hangs out with an outlaw gang in which, Collins, owner of the Golden Rule Saloon, is the secret head. Sheriff Hartley suspects him, but has been unable to gather the needed evidence. Collins instructs his gang, including young Hartley, to hold up the stagecoach on its return trip from Missionary Flats and take the cargo of gold dust it is carrying. Sheriff Hartley is notified of the planned holdup by one of his deputies who has been spying on Collins, and organizes a posse. A deputy-sheriff is killed in the ensuing gunfight between the lawmen and the outlaws, but Deputy Joe Larkin, pursues and captures Clay Hartley Jr. The latter is quickly tried and convicted of the killing of the deputy, and sentenced to be hung. Sheriff Hartley has only a few hours to prove his son was not the killer. He enlists the aid of Collins' step-daughter, Joan, who is in love with Hartley's son.

programme.title: The Sundowners
programme.desc: Brother battles brother in this gritty tale of feuding ranchers in the old west. This story of the Texas panhandle stars such familiar faces as Robert Preston, Chill Wills, and Jack Elam, and was a rare film for its time in that it was filmed almost entirely in Texas with no studio interiors. If for no other reason, watch this one for Prestons performance. If you only know him from The Music Man or Victor Victoria, youre sure to be surprised here! (also, look for John Drew Barrymore as Jef Cloud. He was part of the famous Barrymore family, and father of Drew Barrymore.) Jim Strake: Frank Cordell. The Whip: Dave Kashner. Directed by George Templeton

programme.title: American Empire
programme.desc: This epic of America's westward march stars Leo Carrillo and Preston Foster in a tale of men building a cattle empire, only to battle rustlers, the weather, and each other! The romantic adventure from director William C. McGann (In Old California, Alcatraz Island) features a strong leading performance by Oscar nominated RKO star Richard Dix (Cimarron, The Ghost Ship) plus cinematography by six-time Oscar nominee Russell Harlan (To Kill a Mockingbird, Rio Bravo).

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin (Tall in the Saddle) spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cow town of Abilene, Kansas, coaxing fine performances from the likes of Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Thonda Fleming, and Lloyd Bridges. Saddle up and hang on!

programme.title: Call of the Forest
programme.desc: There's plenty of drama in this tale of lost gold mines, gallant stallions, and fuzzy bears. Starring Ken Curtis, Robert Lowery, and Chief Thundercloud, this charming little film is highlighted by Karl Struss' stunning photography

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: Mason of the Mounted
programme.desc: Canadian Mountie Mason is sent south of the border to look for a horse thief with only a watch chain for evidence. He befriends young Andy and when Calhoun hits Andy, Mason and Calhoun fight. In the scuffle Calhoun's watch with the missing chain is dislodged. Mason then sets out to bring in Calhoun and his gang.

programme.title: The Gay Cavalier
programme.desc: The Cisco Kid, along with Pancho, try to help an unhappy bride.

programme.title: Crashing Thru
programme.desc: Down the danger trail sweeps a crimson fury... as Renfrew rides again! In this action-packed adventure, Sgt. Renfrew must face off against a group of criminals involved in a gold robbery. With his partner, Constable Kelly, wounded in a gunfight, Renfrew must stop the thieves on his own. Directed by Elmer Clifton; starring James Newill and Warren Hull, this is one adventure you won't want to miss!

programme.title: Sunset Carson Rides Again
programme.desc: Sunset Carson is trying to raise money for a new school and his partner Sam Webster is out to stop him. When Carson plans a benefit prize-fight, Webster plans to make off with the proceeds. Direted by Oliver Drake; starring Sunset Carson, Al Terry, Pat Starling, Ron Ormond, Joe Hiser.

programme.title: Texas Brooklyn and Heaven
programme.desc: When Eddie Tayloe (Guy Madison, 5 Against the House) receives $6,000 from his grandfather, he decides to leave his drab newspaper job and move to New York. His dream is to have a play produced on Broadway. Along the way he picks up a pretty hitchhiker (Diana Lynn, The Miracle of Morgan's Creek) who is also leaving her own dreary life for a shot at New York. Unfortunately, they find that the Big Apple is a hard place to make a living. But it's also a city where circumstances keep bringing them together!

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Custer's Last Stand
programme.desc: The survivor of an Indian attack acquires a rare medicine arrow, and a menacing character named Blade (Reed Howes) will stop at nothing to take it from him. Elmer Clifton (Assassin of Youth, Seven Doors to Death) directs a memorable cast that includes Rex Lease (The Sign of the Wolf, The Monster Walks), Lona Andre (Slaves in Bondage, Death in the Air), and William Farnum (Samson and Delilah). Meanwhile, Frank McGlynn Jr is in the title role of General George A. Custer.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: John Wayne plays a man wrongly convicted of murder in this exciting western drama from Lone Star Pictures. You'll enjoy plenty of gun action and thundering hoofbeats as he escapes from jail and then joins a gang, hoping to find the real killer! Director Armand Schaefer (The Miracle Rider, The Lost Jungle) whips up some fine performances from a cast of B-movie favorites, including Lane Chandler (Samson and Delilah) and the great stunt rider, Yakima Canutt. And of course, the film features plenty of fight scenes, made memorable by John Wayne's big swinging' right fist! For film buffs: This was one of 11 films Wayne starred in that year, making 1933 one of the busiest years of Wayne's legendary career.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: Daughter of the West
programme.desc: A FLAMING PAGE FROM AMERICAN HISTORY Becomes a powerful motion picture...set against the panoramic grandeur of the West!. Martha Vickers stars as Lolita Moreno, a convent raised woman in the 1880s who learns about her Native American heritage through her relationship with an educated Navajo. Morena had been raised at a California mission, but when she leaves to teach school in Arizona, the threads of her mysterious past are revealed. This leads to her involvement with some dangerous people, and a chance to find love in the most unexpected way. The cast includes Phillip Reed, Donald Woods, William Farnum and Milton Kibbee. Pedro de Cordobaa stars as Chief Wykomas.

programme.title: Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: Icon of early talking pictures, Harry Carey (Red River), portrays the rugged Trigger Carson, a noble cowboy who infiltrates an outlaw gang in order to expose their rackets. Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: A band of outlaws is terrorizing a town in the West. Leave it to Ray Crash Corrigan and his Range Busters to ride in and save the day. This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: Law of the Pampas
programme.desc: Murder below the Equator...and Hopalong Cassidy races to action in the heart of the wild Pampas country !Hoppy (William Boyd) and his pal Lucky (Russell Hayden) head to South America to look after a herd of cattle sold by Cassidy's boss to an Argentine rancher. Unfortunately, the scoundrel Ralph Merritt (Sidney Blackmer) wants the cattle, and he's not above hiring some dangerous characters to do his dirty work. It's a test of blazing guns...under a blazing sun! Can the boys of Bar 20 lay down the law in a lawless place like the Pampas? Can Hoppy and his gang succeed in what is truly a last frontier? Watch and see!

programme.title: Billy The Kid Returns
programme.desc: Who would ever mistake Roy Rogers for Billy the Kid? That's exactly what happens in this actionpacked horse opera from Republic Pictures. Rogers arrives on the scene shortly after Pat Garrett (Wade Boteler) kills the infamous Billy the Kid (also played by Rogers). Though Billy was a killer, he was on the side of the homesteaders against a coterie of big time ranchers. As Billy's death is unknown to the public, Roy gets Garrett to let him pose as Billy to continue the fight against the ranchers, but without the bloodshed. We also get six songs, including When the Sun is Setting on the Prairie...

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Bad Man of Deadwood
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Gabby Hayes are together again in this Republic Pictures gem. This time theyre trying to set up a medicine show in Deadwood, a town known for dangerous entrepreneurs who dont like competition. Sally Payne is on-hand as a member of the troop where Roy and Gabby work as entertainers, while Carol Adams plays a reporter who may have a romantic interest in Roy. Songs include Song of the Dusty Trail, and Home on the Rangeland.

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Jesse James Rides Again
programme.desc: The outlaw Jesse James and his friend are on the run from the law when he is wrongly accused of leading the historic 1876 Northfield, Minnesota bank robbery. With nerve-tensing turns and high-impact action, Jesse rides into a town where a gang is trying to drive area ranchers off their land because there's oil underneath it. Jesse James takes particular interest in the situation of a pretty young woman and her elderly father, whose ranch is being regularly attacked by the gang.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent!

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: Lost Canyon
programme.desc: When Johnny Travers (Jay Kirby) is falsely accused of robbing a bank, it's up to Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) to clear his name and find the real villains. There's nothing better than watching Hoppy get rough with the rustlers, and it's all the better when you get to hear the Sportsmen Quartette sing (I got Spurs) Jingle, Jangle, Jingle.

programme.title: The Jeweler and the Thief
programme.desc: Justine meets her hubby for the first-time outside prison walls. A jeweler falls for a bank robber. A reformed ex-con fears his locked up lady could spell trouble. A secret wedding spells trouble.

programme.title: Married at Release
programme.desc: A secret release day wedding causes tension. Surprise guests threaten Monique's plans. Jeweler Ashley is terrified to tell the truth about her bank-robbing boyfriend. Justine and Michael's sexy reunion as husband and wife.

programme.title: Good News, Bad News
programme.desc: John's schocking discovery about Lacey. Andrea faces Lamar's daughter; Kristianna's big news changes everything. Scott uncovers the truth about Lindsey.

programme.title: From Felon to Fiance
programme.desc: Johnna plans wedding after Garrett's prison release, despite her dad's doubts. Andrea has a meltdown at her Mormon bridal shower!

programme.title: New Warden in Town
programme.desc: Garrett's guys' night spoils sexy reunion; Johnna's betrayed when she sees his true colors. James rushes to Alla after her release.

programme.title: Meet the Parents
programme.desc: Lizzie's release is met with devastating news. After weeks of no ring, Garrett makes an expensive purchase that upsets Johnna.

programme.title: Surprises and Sentences
programme.desc: Alla fears she may be pregnant. Garrett has a birthday surprise for Johnna. Shocking news from Lizzie's lawyer leaves Scott in shambles.

programme.title: Race to the Altar
programme.desc: Ex-gangbanger Lamar meets fiancee Andrea's Mormon kids and they fear for her safety. Johnna's dad doubts Garrett's proposal.

programme.title: Prison Cell to Wedding Bells
programme.desc: In their race to the altar, Johnna shocks Garrett. Andrea's huge sacrifice brings on a major wedding day meltdown. Alla faces James after rehab.

programme.title: I Want This To Be Real
programme.desc: When Scott fears he's Lizzie's "trick", he has a major meltdown that leads to their first fight. At Matt's release, Caitlin "inspects" her man.

programme.title: Washing Off Prison
programme.desc: Matt & Caitlin's sexy reunion leads to a surprising offer. At Tracie's release, Clint fears she's catfishing him.

programme.title: Secrets and Cellmates
programme.desc: Ex-con Michael juggles wife & girlfriend. Lizzie gives Scott a makeover but her daughter wants him out. Clint proposes the same day he meets Tracie.

programme.title: Rings and Runaways
programme.desc: Michael ring shops with his wife but plans a secret trip with girlfriend. Clint marries bride Tracie but he awakens to a nightmare.

programme.title: She Said Yes?
programme.desc: Scott stuns Lizzie. Megan & Michael rendezvous for the first time outside of prison but wife Sarah has a shocking secret.

programme.title: Wife on the Run
programme.desc: After being MIA, Michael is confronted by wife Sarah. Brittany suggests a threesome with her ex. Clint seeks legal advice when his missing wife is locked up.

programme.title: She Has To Go
programme.desc: Megan's last-minute visit shakes Michael when his mom objects. Brittany's party turns left when her ex arrives & she's forced to reveal her secret.

programme.title: Visits & Violations
programme.desc: A visit from Megan leads Michael to a shocking violation. Scott fears telling Lizzie he's broke. Caitlin battles grief & Matt after mom's loss.

programme.title: Sorry, Not Sorry
programme.desc: Sarah's shocking discovery sends her racing to meet Megan. Scott & Lizzie unravel over a major blow-up. Marcelino stuns Brittany with a surprising offer.

programme.title: Prison Blues to Wedding Bells
programme.desc: Megan & Sarah face off in an epic showdown. Brittany's ex-girlfriend shows up to her wedding to Marcelino. Tracie is set free but will Clint show?

programme.title: Inmate or Soulmate?
programme.desc: Dad fears felon fiance but Lacey is keeping a surprising secret. Cheryl shocks sister when she drops $30K on inmate.

programme.title: Felon Fantasy
programme.desc: Cheryl stuns mom with bombshell about felon fiancé. Lacey risks all for Shane's release. Andrea freaks when Lamondre blows up.

programme.title: Rule Breakers & Love Makers
programme.desc: Kevin is stunned when he's not the only man at Tiffany's release. Rick fears he's being played. Harry's in trouble when the cops pull him over. Tayler makes a shocking discovery about Chance. Kaylah and Martel's reunion goes left.

programme.title: Get Right or Get Left
programme.desc: Chaos erupts when Kevin & Kurtis face off at Tiffany's release. Chazz plans fifth marriage to an inmate. Harry reunites with his daughter and baby mama. Lacey picks up Antoine, but tensions flare. Chance sends Tayler's sister storming off.

programme.title: Ex-tra Stress
programme.desc: Indie's date with Harry takes a shocking turn. Chazz is bummed when Branwin's ex shows up to her release. Kevin's torn between Tiffany and Kayla. Rick and Raydean are at odds over her prison girlfriend. Antoine's mom sours his reunion with Lacey.

programme.title: What Are You Hiding?
programme.desc: Branwin marries Chazz on her release day. Tiffany catches Kevin red-handed. Tayler gets an unexpected call putting pressure on Chance. Rick fears Raydean is hiding something. Lacey takes Antoine car shopping, but has reservations.

programme.title: Deny, Deny, Deny
programme.desc: Tayler's unexpected crisis sends Chance into a meltdown. Branwin reaches out to an ex on her wedding day. Indie confronts Harry about his other woman. Raydean drops a bombshell. Antoine catches Lacey in a lie.

programme.title: What's Love Gotta Do With It?
programme.desc: Harry's stunned when Indie's bountyhunter mom pulls up on him. Branwin's daughter is suspicious of Chazz. Tayler's sister returns and faces off with Chance. Antoine reunites with Lacey's frenemy, his mother. Raydean and Ramona argue over Rick.

programme.title: Love is a Sickness
programme.desc: Lacey meets ex-con at release, then gets caught in a lie. Angela lusts for Tony on first date, but a race to the halfway house threatens all.

programme.title: Indecent Proposals
programme.desc: Cheryl & Josh's sexy reunion is threatened when bad news sends Cheryl over the edge. Angela's shocked by a surprising offer.

programme.title: The Mother of All Surprises
programme.desc: Tony shocks Angela with alarming news. Cheryl breaks down when Josh's mom makes a shocking accusation. Tensions ignite between Lizzy & Daniel's mom.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Con
programme.desc: Angela searches for her fugitive fiancé, Tony, on the run from the police. Lacey drops a bombshell on Shane. Amber questions Vince's shocking prison hustle.

programme.title: Menace to Society
programme.desc: Detective drops bombshell on Andrea about inmate fiancé. Cheryl loses it when Josh reveals shocking charges. Amber's friend suspects Vince is a con.

programme.title: Snitches Get Stitches
programme.desc: Lizzy's dangerous encounter with an ex threatens Daniel's freedom & her secret. Shane's bold move stuns Lacey. Cheryl & Josh's risky search.

programme.title: Love the Way You Lie
programme.desc: Angela makes a shocking discovery about Tony. Lacey drops another bombshell on Shane. Glorietta & Alex's romantic dinner takes a turn.

programme.title: Love or Con?
programme.desc: Lacey awaits fiancé John's release, but new lover threatens all. Amber reveals Puppy's secret plan. Tony begs Angela for a second chance.

programme.title: Blinded by Love
programme.desc: Old sparks reignite when Lacey has a secret rendezvous with John. Angela interrogates Tony. Daniel stuns family with shocking reveal.

programme.title: Where Are They Now?
programme.desc: One year later the cast dishes on juicy secrets, social media gossip, cheating scandals & arrests! They relive the most dramatic moments and add insight.

programme.title: Stairway to Heaven
programme.desc: John plans a pickup truck wedding. Scott moves 1,200 miles for a felon he's never met. Jessica's family opposes her marriage to a gang member. Shawn risks his 401k for an inmate. Shavel's family thinks Quaylon is guilty until proven innocent.

programme.title: Bad at Being Good
programme.desc: Shawn's confession leaves his daughter in tears. Tensions run high on Maurice's release day. Scott has an emotional reunion with Lindsey's daughter. John's over the top gesture stuns Kristianna. Quaylon's double cross leaves Shavel reeling.

programme.title: Date with Destinie
programme.desc: Shawn finds out if Destinie is a catfish; Shavel breaks down before Quaylon's release; Scott prepares to spoil Lindsey; Tyrice clashes with his BFF over Chanda; Jessica and Maurice have a sexy reunion; John proposes an instant wedding to Kristianna.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: Kristianna makes a life-changing decision. Scott searches for Lindsey. Tyrice faces off against his disapproving family. A parole condition devastates Maurice. Quaylon reunites with Shavel…and his mother. Destinie catches Shawn in a shocking lie.

programme.title: Roses on the Bed
programme.desc: Quaylon is caught in the middle between his mom and Shavel. Tyrice dresses to the nines for Chanda's release. Jessica struggles to find her place in Maurice's life in Compton. Scott demands answers. Destinie reveals she has secrets of her own.

programme.title: A Gamble in the Desert
programme.desc: Shawn meets Destinie's wild side in Sin City. Quaylon faces a grilling from Shavel's mom. A desperate Maurice makes a risky move. John's news shocks his mother-in-law. A surprising phone call spoils Tyrice's plans for Chanda's release.

programme.title: Denied & Declined
programme.desc: Destinie gets more than she bargained for at the furniture store. Heather prepares a sexy surprise for her fiancé Dylan's release. Shavel's extravagant gift for Quaylon enrages her family. Kristianna battles her demons during an emotional reunion.

programme.title: Love Don't Cost a Ring
programme.desc: Shavel and Quaylon's families clash at his welcome home party. Maurice faces Jessica's parents. Kristianna's risky rendezvous threatens everything. Scott receives shocking news about Lindsey. Destinie explodes after discovering a secret.

programme.title: Put a Sweater on and Chill
programme.desc: Quaylon starts to crack under pressure from Shavel. Jessica's secret stuns Maurice. Dylan begins to see Heather's true colors. Scott tries to get on Lindsey's good side. Shawn's betrayal may be Destinie's final straw.

programme.title: The Home Wrecker & The Nervous Wreck
programme.desc: Raydean drops a bombshell on Rick. Lacey confronts Antoine about cheating accusations. Kevin wants an answer from Tiffany. Chance puts his heart on the line. Indie is faced with a big decision. Branwin has a breakdown. Martel keeps a secret.

programme.title: The Jeweler and the Thief
programme.desc: Justine meets her hubby for the first-time outside prison walls. A jeweler falls for a bank robber. A reformed ex-con fears his locked up lady could spell trouble. A secret wedding spells trouble.

programme.title: Married at Release
programme.desc: A secret release day wedding causes tension. Surprise guests threaten Monique's plans. Jeweler Ashley is terrified to tell the truth about her bank-robbing boyfriend. Justine and Michael's sexy reunion as husband and wife.

programme.title: Love After Lockup
programme.desc: Channel

programme.title: Ditched and Dismissed
programme.desc: Justine gets heated with Michael's mom at a family reunion. Nathan's behavior shocks Skylar at her release. Gabby discovers her husband's lies. Derek has an unexpected visitor during Monique's romantic dinner.

programme.title: Felons 4 Life
programme.desc: Skylar fears the worst when Nathan goes M.I.A. A mysterious car chase threatens Monique and Derek. Ashley plans a romantic date, but keeps a secret. Michael's music manager pushes Justine's buttons. Cameron hatches a wild plan at his re-release.

programme.title: Freak in the Sheets
programme.desc: Britney panics when Ray's release takes a shocking turn. Nicolle's secret complicates Daonte's big sex-pectations. Lisa's surprising confession leaves Stan worried if she'll show up. Rachel finally meets her husband in the free world.

programme.title: Trials & Tribulations
programme.desc: Tracie celebrates freedom, but Clint is keeping a big secret. Michael risks all when he threatens parole.

programme.title: Dope Spoons & Second Honeymoons
programme.desc: Tracie explodes when Clint's secret is revealed. Scott's proposal takes a turn when Lizzie makes a shocking accusation.

programme.title: Close Calls

programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

She continues with a potato au gratin that has been baked to perfection for a rich, savoury finish, and is layered with cold cuts and cheese. A delightful combination of hearty indulgence and sweet tradition.

programme.desc: Memoirs 02 October

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: Naples is Italy in the extreme. We’ll prowl backstreet fish markets and dodge speedy Vespas before indulging in pizza where it was invented. Afterward, we'll climb to the top of nearby Mount Vesuvius, then wander through the ruins of Pompeii, the Roman town it destroyed.

programme.title: Dates that made History
programme.sub-title: S01:E01 399 BC The Trial Of Socrates
programme.desc: 399 BC: The Trial of Socrates dramatises the famous trial of the Greek philosopher Socrates, who is charged with corrupting the youth and impiety. The episode delves into Socrates' defence, his philosophical ideas, and his unwavering commitment to his principles. It explores the tension between individual thought and the societal norms of ancient Athens. Through this trial, the show examines the impact of Socrates' ideas on Western philosophy and his legacy.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Sevilla
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Seville, Spain — a vibrant city in the heart of Andalusia known for its rich Moorish heritage, flamenco music, and stunning architecture. She visits iconic landmarks like the Seville Cathedral, Plaza de España, and the Royal Alcázar, while also discovering local tapas bars and lively streets filled with culture and charm.

programme.title: Womanity
programme.desc: The story of the "positive force" that women exert in society: in the family environment as in communities, in the workplace as well as in politics, a force and an action able to always act, despite the numerous difficulties.

programme.title: The Great Greek Myths
programme.sub-title: S01:E09 Greek Myths: Dedalus and Icarus - A Shattered Dream
programme.desc: The tale of Daedalus and Icarus: A Shattered Dream follows a brilliant inventor and his son as they attempt to escape captivity with wings crafted from feathers and wax. Fueled by ambition, their flight reaches daring heights—but the dream is fragile. What follows is a powerful lesson on hubris, freedom, and the fine line between aspiration and downfall. A myth etched in the skies of human longing and loss.

programme.title: Concerto - OSN Marc Albrecht E Simone Lamsma Torino
programme.sub-title: Concerto - OSN Marc Albrecht E Simone Lamsma Torino
programme.desc: In this 2022 concert in Turin, Marc Albrecht conducts the Orchestra Sinfonica Nazionale della Rai, with Simone Lamsma as the violin soloist. The programme includes Shostakovich's Violin Concerto No. 1, showcasing Lamsma's technical brilliance and emotional depth, and Franck's Symphony in D minor, celebrated for its rich harmonies and cyclical structure. The performance highlights a powerful blend of passion and precision.

programme.title: Gold Cuisine
programme.desc: A sweet and comforting duo with skillet apple pie, warm and fragrant with tender apples and buttery crust, paired with soft, chocolatey crinkle cookies. An episode celebrating indulgent desserts and the cozy flavors of home baking.

programme.title: Split (Firule)
programme.desc: In Split’s Firule neighborhood—home to Croatia’s tennis greats—we discovered more than just sport. Renowned chef Hrvoje Zirojević welcomed us with a taste of tradition: pivac na tingul, a classic Dalmatian stew made with tender young rooster.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Lisbon
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Lisbon, the vibrant capital of Portugal. Once founded by the Phoenicians and shaped by Romans, Moors, and explorers of the Golden Age, Lisbon’s layered history is reflected in its culture and charm. During her visit, the city comes alive with the Festas Populares de Lisboa — a June celebration of Saint Anthony filled with music, dancing, and barbecued sardines. Malini samples local favorites like grilled sardines, bifanas, and the famous pastel de nata, and experiences the soulful beauty of Fado music. Lisbon’s warmth, flavor, and festive spirit show why it remains one of Europe’s most beloved cities.

programme.title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.sub-title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

Take a trip of inspiration, exploration, and adventure with hosts Panicos Pilalis and Aristo Aristeidou. Listen and get motivated to go on your own outdoor adventure in Cyprus!

It probably won't stay on the market for long at this price.

programme.title: The tapestries of the Grand Master Restoration
programme.sub-title: The tapestries of the Grand Master Restoration
programme.desc: Towards the end of summer 1710, a precious cargo was unloaded on the shores of the Grand Harbour. Whoever opened that merchandise and laid eyes on it for the first time must surely have been astonished by its beauty. The tapestries of the Grand Master’s Palace had arrived in Malta. Watch their 300-year-old story unfold in this documentary by Heritage Malta.

programme.title: La Firenze dei Medici
programme.desc: Explore the profound influence of the Medici family on the history of Florence, highlighting their rule from the 15th to the 16th century. The focus is on Lorenzo Il Magnifico, the era's most renowned figure. Through his life, we delve into iconic works linked to the Medici, including the masterpiece of architecture, the Dome of Santa Maria del Fiore, designed by Filippo Brunelleschi. The episode also features Florence’s own Sergio Staino, a celebrated designer and cartoonist, offering a unique perspective on the city’s rich cultural legacy.

programme.title: Paestum e Velia colonie greche d' Occidente
programme.sub-title: Paestum e Velia colonie greche d' Occidente
programme.desc: A journey from Greece to Italy during the archaic era involved diverse human groups settling in Southern Italy, which led to the establishment of Magna Grecia. Discover the archaeological sites of Poseidonia, Paestum, and Elea, Velia, where recent excavations have uncovered ancient temples and artefacts, revealing the region's rich history of cultural exchange and maritime conflicts.

programme.title: Black Petals
programme.desc: A single mum of two does all she can to meet the needs of her children but what happens when her son gets married to a controlling wife and is in debt to his father-in-law?

programme.title: 31 Days
programme.desc: Two young corpers find themselves in the unknown when they are assigned to a small village for their youth service and try to teach new ways of doing things that defy the village's traditions.

programme.title: Check-Mate
programme.desc: Jada, suspicious about her husband's reason for always being tired, decides to hire an escort to test his fidelity. Things don't go according to plan, and she puts their relationship into jeopardy.

programme.title: Blatant Denial
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A vehicle inspection goes wrong with Inspector Farouk and deputy Akpan. They escape the long arm of the law, but karma finds a way to get justice.

programme.title: Uptight
programme.desc: Sonia's temper pushes everyone away from her, leaving her unlucky in love. She finally meets Leon, who is patient and wants to be with her, but her erratic behaviour leaves him questioning his decision.

programme.title: Roses Are Red
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. After a successful heart surgery, Samuel wakes up a completely different man. However, his sudden interest in art, classical literature goes contrary to his previous self.

programme.title: The Cheerleaders
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Three lovely ladies form a group with one desire; stay away from love and use men only for their own selfish desires. However, two of them fall in love and create a crack in the group. The remaining one stays true to the creed of The Cheerleaders and stays off love and men. But love would eventually puncture through the tough wall she had built against it and she would come to find out one thing in the end; everybody can find true love.

programme.title: Fashion Insider - Idia Aisien
programme.desc: Discover new designers, trends, styles, and more at Fashion Insider. Elileojo Achebo provides you with the opportunity to gain first-hand knowledge of the African stylists of the moment.

programme.title: Surrogate
programme.desc: A young, beautiful and very intelligent girl from a poor background gets a scholarship to study in Lagos, managing life until her father falls sick and needs a heart valve. Desperate to gather the funds, she accepts to become the surrogate to a wealthy man who only desires a child without the entanglement of marriage.

programme.title: Swap Identity
programme.desc: A woman lets a close friend into her home, not realising that she is jeopardising her relationship.

programme.title: Legal Love
programme.desc: A lawyer and a company owner's son navigate a complex relationship, initially marked by tension. Their connection unexpectedly deepens, while a hidden agenda threatens their burgeoning romance.

programme.title: Shades Of Love
programme.desc: The constant argument between a young couple threatens to break their bond, leaving them wondering if love is enough.

programme.title: Alone With Love
programme.desc: In a bid to prove her love and commitment to her relationship with John, Precious makes a mistake that will change the course of both their lives forever.

programme.title: Dear Father
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Dami is a young woman who doesn’t know she has to stay as far away as possible from her past. When she goes seeking answers to discover who she is, she opens a pandora's box that seems impossible to close.

programme.title: Meet The Surrogate Mum
programme.desc: What started off as a remedy for bearing children becomes a redemption from a loveless and worrisome marriage.

programme.title: Married To The Enemy
programme.desc: Feyi's resentments of his wife, Prisca's successful career results in him belittling her every chance he gets. Things get worse when she falls pregnant and she decides enough is enough.

programme.title: Golden Spoon
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Following the death of his mother, Jaiye is left to run her restaurant, The Golden Spoon, which has been bankrupt for a while. Days after her funeral, Jaiye is surprised to find out that he must either pay the bank loan taken by his mother for the restaurant or it would be permanently closed. As he struggles with this news, a series of unfortunate events take place in the restaurant causing him to consider what else can possibly go wrong.

programme.title: Family Friends
programme.desc: The feud between two families has a devastating effect on the relationship between two best friends.

programme.title: Shaffy's Sister
programme.desc: Shaffy’s sister, Daisy, struggles to interact with her family and find her place in society after spending years in prison.

programme.title: Gossip Grid Ep1
programme.desc: All the Nollywood news in bite size.

programme.title: Composure
programme.desc: A marriage begins to suffer after the couple lose their unborn child. Things take a turn for the worse when the wife discovers her husband has been unfaithful and her mental health starts to spiral out of control.

programme.title: The Hangout S6 Ep4
programme.desc: The Hangout returns for its sixth season with a group of opinionated, social media-savvy millennials who debate controversial topics on love, sex, friendship, and more.

programme.title: Vague
programme.desc: The strained relationship between Daniel and Melody gets worse when he invites his recently widowed friend, Dozie, to move in with them temporarily. Things start to fall apart when Dozie starts to comfort Melody due to Daniel's neglect.

programme.title: Coincidental Love
programme.desc: In the quest of getting a man to impress her nosy sister and brother in-law, Pearl gets entangled with Kennedy, who pretends to be Pearl's blind date, Jerry, someone she has hired to help her out. When Pearl finds out this lie, she kicks Kennedy out of her house but they keep crossing paths.

programme.title: Wrong Choice
programme.desc: Simi, a lady with very high standards, dumps her struggling boyfriend, Victor, for the dashing Femi, who she believes will fulfill her material needs.

programme.title: Car Heist
programme.desc: Two police recruits witness the murder of a foreigner and decide to steal the million-dollar cash left in the victim's car, but their plan keeps on failing.

programme.title: The House Keeper
programme.desc: Adamma leaves her village and moves to the city with her aunt, Patricia. She soon finds out that city life is not all it's cracked up to be, when Patricia and her friends try to recruit Adamma into their line of work.

programme.title: Find Her & Marry Her
programme.desc: When Kennedy's friend advices him to stay away from "city girls", he throws away his relationship to meet a girl from the village, but soon finds himself in over his head.

programme.title: My Father's Property
programme.desc: An escalating dispute regarding property between two brothers takes a deadly turn as each brother refuses to back down.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Crown
programme.desc: Lolade, a gifted shoemaker living under her aunt’s harsh rules, secretly builds her dream brand. After accidentally attacking a disguised Prince Ayoola, she later discovers his true identity, and that her fate is in his hands, when she pitches her designs at a village funding event.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Arutoghor, a gentle and kind-hearted bachelor, has always been in love with Tarini, even being the shoulder she cries on when her boyfriend, Lambert, a selfish, short-tempered man, breaks her heart. Unable to endure the torture that comes with being friend zoned, Arutoghor expresses his love for Tarini and threatens to end their friendship if they can't be lovers. Tarini decides to take him on his offer which leads to marriage but is her heart truly his now?

programme.title: Gossip Grid Ep1
programme.desc: All the Nollywood news in bite size.

programme.title: Swivel
programme.desc: The marriage of Deji & Ebere is in serious jeopardy when they start working for the same organisation. They find it difficult to balance their marriage and their careers, and things are made worse when Ebere starts to outshine Deji in the workplace.

programme.title: A Perfect Girlfriend
programme.desc: When being friends with benefits is no longer enough, what do you do? A woman falls in love with her male best friend but has to watch him dating other women.

programme.title: The Missing Package
programme.desc: In The Missing Package, Detective Lazarus is almost done for the day when an unassuming middle-aged man walks in and reports a package he is expecting missing, but more importantly is the carrier who seems to have disappeared into thin air. This sets Detective Lazarus on a wild goose chase to find what appears to be a package determined not to be found and a carrier who appears to no longer exist.

programme.title: AMC Red Carpet - A Mama Deola Wedding
programme.desc: AMC Red Carpet moments brings you exclusive red carpet interviews with Nollywood stars at the premieres of top Nollywood movies and other industry events such as award ceremonies.

programme.title: Greed
programme.desc: A young man's plan for marriage is thwarted due to him being unemployed and not having a home of his own. Whilst this is going on he is pressured by his family to take more responsibility for his life.

programme.title: Home Apart
programme.desc: The sibling rivalry between Vivian and Helen intensifies dramatically when a romantic interest comes into play, pushing one sister to take extreme measures.

programme.title: The Red Honeymoon
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A young and happy couple, Sylvia and Tolu, go for their honeymoon after a sweet wedding ceremony. Suddenly, Tolu disappears from their hotel room, leaving Sylvia distraught. Is there something else hidden underneath her outward signs of grief?

programme.title: Little Lies
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Ruth, a young widow, finds out about her husband’s other wife when she visits the morgue to claim his body. She is confused about this situation and confronts the mystery woman, where she finds out that her husband has two names and two different identities. The mystery continues when she discovers his phone keeps getting messages in different languages. She resolves to taking the matter to the DSS but is dismissed, causing her to go to the press but she is suddenly threatened by unknown gunmen and asked to run away forever.

programme.title: A Raisinette In The Sun
programme.desc: Even though he doesn't agree, Eddie backs up Kenny's claim that the cashier at a fancy new movie theater discriminated against him because he's black.

programme.title: Sob Story
programme.desc: Eddie's inability to cry at the movies leads Joy to suggest they attend a couples workshop to help unlock his emotions.

programme.title: Dreamguys
programme.desc: After Eddie refuses to comfort her following a nightmare, Joy finds a willing ear in Kenny.

programme.title: Sugar Dougie
programme.desc: Eddie and Joy reconsider their plan to break up Allison and Doug after they discover that his family is very rich.

programme.title: Ex-Factor
programme.desc: Joy's interest in Eddie soars after learning that he dated her classy new friend before they were married.

programme.title: Snore Loser
programme.desc: After Kenny's complaints about his snoring send Eddie to a sleep clinic for a cure, Joy discovers that she can't sleep without all the noise.

programme.title: The Perfect Couple
programme.desc: Joy invites a new couple for dinner, only to be left out after they become Eddie's new best friends.

programme.title: Ally Abroad
programme.desc: After a car accident lands Doug at their house to recover, Eddie and Joy look for a way to head off his sudden plans to marry their daughter.

programme.title: Family Vacation
programme.desc: After agreeing to take Doug and Kenny along on their family vacation to Florida, Joy and Eddie's bickering causes a bride-to-be to have second thoughts about getting married.

programme.title: Dog Fight
programme.desc: The Starks employ role playing to spice up their sex life, while Kenny looks to make a career out of returning lost pets to their grateful owners.

programme.title: The Christmas Show
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.title: The Nanny-In-Law
programme.desc: Fran contends with Maxwell's old nanny.

programme.title: A Plot For Nanny
programme.desc: Fran's birthday gift leads to a date with a handsome mortician.

programme.title: The Show Must Go On
programme.sub-title: S1:E12 The Show Must Go On
programme.desc: Fran and Maxwell clash over Grace's school pageant.

programme.title: Maggie The Model
programme.desc: Chloe Simpson, a 1960s supermodel, re-enters ex-flame Maxwell's life, turning the Sheffield household upside down and interfering with the relationship between Fran and Maggie.

programme.title: The Family Plumbing
programme.desc: Maxwell reveals he has a double standard when it comes to his children and the opposite sex.

programme.title: Deep Throat
programme.desc: While examining Grace for symptoms of the flu, the doctor takes a look at Fran's throat and immediately orders her to the hospital to have her tonsils removed. Meanwhile, C.C. convinces Maxwell to attend her college reunion -- as her "amour," but her plans are foiled when Maxwell stands her up in order to stay by Fran's bedside.

programme.title: Schlepped Away
programme.desc: The entire Sheffield clan, including C.C. and Fran, spends the weekend "vacationing" at Fran's parents' house when a blizzard closes the airports and maroons them in Queens. While stranded at the Fines' home, Maggie falls for the boy next door, C.C. crawls in bed with Niles, and Fran finds a love note to her mother -- that's not from her father.

programme.title: The Moving Finger
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: A Strange Little Visitor
programme.desc: Walter and Margaret Brocken ask Samantha to keep their son Merle, a ten year old warlock, while they attend a witches convention. When Merle agrees not to do any magic before Darrin, Samantha invites him to stay. Meanwhile, Larry Tate asks Darrin to keep an expensive necklace, a birthday present for. his wife, at the Stephens home. Darrin goes to Merle's room, where the young warlock has turned a hairbrush into a model fire engine, which flashes with electric shocks when Darrin touches it. Darrin shouts with pain until Merle turns off the current. Samantha is now forced to disclose that Merle is a warlock. Merle again promises Samantha to refrain from magic in the house. That night a burglar who had seen Larry giving Darrin the necklace breaks in and overpowers Darrin. Darrin calls on Merle for a magical assist, but Merle stands by his promise. When the burglar finds the necklace, Darrin cons him into taking the fire engine too. As he reaches for it, Merle turns on his magic. Later, Gladys is more bewildered than ever as she hears the burglar explaining to the police how he was captured by a toy fire engine.

programme.title: Fastest Gun On Madison Avenue
programme.desc: Joe Kovack makes a play for Samantha in a restaurant. Darrin rushes to her defense. Realizing Darrin faces certain slaughter, Samantha twitches her nose and Joe falls to the floor, Since Joe is Number One contender for the heavyweight title, newspapers hail Darrin as a coming champ. Darrin pleads with Samantha to let him fight, his own battles. Then, Joe and his Manager, trying to regain a crack at a lucrative championship bout, approach Darrin with a plan for a make-believe bout in which Joe pretends to knock Darrin out. Again, Darrin with the uncalled-on help of Samantha K.O.'s Joe. Finally, Darrin runs into Tommy Carter, the champ-himself. An unplanned for scuffle takes place. Tommy trips and knocks himself out. Later, Larry Tate tells Darrin he has solved the problem by hiring Tommy. Tommy's first assignment is to fight a four-round bout for charity. Darrin quakes at learning that Tommy is to choose his opponent. However, he sadly concludes that with Samantha insisting on being his second, he can't help winning again.

programme.title: Double Tate
programme.desc: For his birthday, Endora decides to make three of Darrin's wishes come true. Unaware of the gift, Darrin gets immediate elevator service in his office building, and they see a bikini-clad beauty. An important client, Randolph Turgeon, insists on seeing Larry Tate, who is in Chicago. Wishing he were Larry for just one day, Darrin immediately turns into his boss. Turgeon introduces Darrin-Larry to his niece, Joyce, who wants a job with the agency. Louise Tate, who thinks her husband is with another woman, slaps her face, and makes him come home. Darrin phones Samantha for help. She arrives immediately, but is un-able to remove the spell. Just as Samantha is telling Darrin--Larry the spell will be over in fifteen minutes, Larry himself walks in. Hoping to keep the confusion from getting worse, Samantha puts Louise to sleep, and tells Larry his wife has been sleep-walking. Safe at home, Samantha tells Darrin Louise will feel she dreamed the whole episode. She asks Darrin what his first two wishes were. He mentions the elevator but decides to forget the girl in the bikini.

programme.title: Samantha, The Dressmaker
programme.desc: Samantha tries unsuccessfully to make her own dress for an affair at the home of an agency client, J.T. Glendon. Whisking Samantha to Paris, Endora takes her to the showroom of Aubert, a couturier who has failed in his attempts to break into the American market. Back home, Samantha uses magic to duplicate an Aubert original. Doris, J.T,'s wife admires the dress. Suddenly. Samantha finds herself committed to making dresses for Doris, J.T.'s sister, Ethel, and Gladys Kravitz. Darrin reveals J.T.'s party is a preview of original creations by his new client, Aubert. Samantha is stunning but the other three women look awful in their creations. Aubert faints when he sees the women wearing his "originals." Later Darrin tells Samantha that Aubert, certain he has been doublecrossed, is suing the agency. Samantha convinces Aubert that he has failed in the American market because he hasn't created dresses for women like Doris and Gladys. With Aubert designing, Samantha finishes dresses for another show in which even Gladys is a standout.

programme.title: Djinn & Water
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: Whatever Became Of Baby Custer?
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: Where'd You Go-Go?
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: Russian Roulette
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: The Leprechaun
programme.desc: Darrin reacts violently when he finds Brian O'Brian, a sprightly leprechaun, a guest in his home. Samantha tells him that Brian is not her relative but the leprechaun of Darrin's family. Brian reveals he has come to recover his pot of gold which was hidden in a fireplace brought to America by James Dennis Robinson. Darrin finds that Robinson owns a company whose account would be a great asset to Darrin's agency. Brian breaks into Robinson's house to retrieve the gold and is arrested. Darrin allows Samantha to use her magic to get Brian out of jail. Brian pleads with Samantha to help him recover his pot of gold which will restore his lost powers. Pledging Brian never to tell Darrin, Samantha returns with him to the Robinson's house. Robinson finds them in his study and reveals he has already removed the pot from the fireplace. Samantha is sur-prised when Robinson tells her he believes the leprechaun's story because his grandfather was a Mahoney, and returns Brian's pot of gold. Brian agrees to allow Robinson to use his picture as a trade mark if Robinson turns his advertising over to Darrin.

programme.title: I, Darrin, Take This Witch Samantha
programme.desc: Samantha and Darrin appear to be an ideally matched couple. Very much in love, they decide to marry. Darrin doesn't know that Samantha, is, of all things, a witch. On their wedding night, Samantha's mother, Endora, a witch, of course, visits her daughter. Regretting that her daughter has married a mortal, she is bent on breaking up the marriage. After pleading with her mother not to interfere, Samantha decides to tell her husband that he has unknowingly married a witch. To convince Darrin of her magic powers, Samantha performs a series of tricks. Darrin makes her promise never to practice her witchcraft again. Sheila, a former girl friend of Darrin's, invites the newly-weds to a dinner party. She makes every effort to embarrass Samantha before the guests. After enduring Sheila's snubs and insults, Samantha cannot resist evening the score. She employs her extraordinary powers to humiliate Sheila. Later, at home, Darrin rebukes his wife, but admits Sheila deserved the tricks played on her.

programme.title: It Shouldn't Happen to a Dog
programme.desc: Samantha gives a dinner party to impress Rex Barker, one of Darrin's clients. Rex brings along his date, Babs Livingston, but advances on Samantha in the garden when he gets drunk.

programme.title: Mother Meet What's His Name
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz, a neighbor, is unable to convince her husband, Abner, that strange things seem to be happening at the Stephens' home. Gladys, June Foster, and Shirley Clyde, with their sons, visit the Stephens' home to welcome Samantha to the community. Gladys is frustrated in her attempts to point out to her friends the amazing number of objects which seem to appear and disappear. When the boys pester Endora, Samantha's mother, she uses magic to tie the three of them up. On leaving, Gladys tries to point out to her friends that it would be physically impossible for three boys to tie themselves up. Later Darrin returns home for his first meeting with Endora. Endora and Darrin soon engage in a heated argument about their opposing viewpoints on life. Endora threatens to turn Darrin into as artichoke. Later Samantha expresses her love for Darrin by announcing that if Endora had done so, she would also have turned herself into an artichoke.

programme.title: My Master, The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Tony tells Jeannie he enjoys cold weather. She starts a snowstorm and the flakes fall on Dr. Bellows. Determined to discover the explanation for the strange happenings around Tony, Dr. Bellows tells Gen. Peterson

programme.title: What House Across The Street
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: Too Many Tonys
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: The Richest Astronaut In The Whole Wide World
programme.desc: Roger discovers the secret of Jeannie's existence when he accidentally releases her from her bottle.

programme.title: Little Pitchers Have Big Fears
programme.desc: Darrin discovers that Samantha has been entertaining a guest each morning after he leaves for work. the guest is ten year old Marshall Burns. Marshall's mother is a widow, whose over-protectiveness has robbed Marshall of all his self-confidence. Darrin tells Samantha that she has no right to interfere with Mrs. Burns' upbringing of her son. Despite Marshall's belief that he is no good at anything, Samantha takes him to a Junior League ball game. Marshall has never been able to make the team. Floyd Kravitz, nephew of Gladys Kravitz, is the star player. With a little witchery on Samantha's part, Marshall becomes a triple threat. When his mother, fearful that he may be inured, forbids him to play, Marshall runs away from home. Samantha and Darrin drive Mrs. Burns to the ball field. There, Marshall, in his own right, has continued to star. How-ever, when Marshall gets into a tight spot, Darrin forbids Samantha from interfering. Marshall makes it on his own. Proud of her son, Mrs. Burns is not unhappy when Coach Gribben suggests that he visit the Burns home to give Marshall some extra coaching.

programme.title: The Witches Are Out
programme.desc: Samantha, her friends, Bertha and Mary, and her Aunt Clara, all witches, decide to change the popular conception of witches into a more flattering image. Their opportunity arises when Darrin, an ad man, is assigned to devise a trademark for a new type of Halloween candy. Mr. Brinkman, the promoter of the candy, wants the trademark to show a traditional witch. Darrin at first agrees, but when he sees how upset Samantha becomes, he decides to present a beautiful witch. Mr. Brinkman objects, but Darrin refuses to yield. Con-sequently, he is fired. The witches decide to practice some of their pranks on Mr. Brinkman. As a topper, they transform him into an ugly old witch. Mr. Brinkman finally admits that his idea of witches is wrong. He agrees to use a glamorous witch for his trademark. Samantha wins her point, and Darrin wins back his job.

programme.title: The Girl Reporter
programme.desc: Teenager Liza Randall interviews Darrin about his career in advertising for a school newspaper. After Darrin takes Liza to the agency on Saturday, Liza's jealous boy friend, Marvin "Monster" Grogan, visits Samantha. Monster, a football star, wants to batter Darrin. Samantha, stuffing Monster with food, explains the innocence of Darrin and Lisa's relationship, although she knows Liza is more than interested in Darrin. At the office, Liza pours drinks. Liza and Darrin are doused when Darrin tries to take the drink away from her. Darrin escapes an awkward situation when boss Larry Tate arrives with two prospective clients . Meanwhile, Monster takes a romantic interest in Samantha. Darrin and Liza arrive, reeking of liquor. Darrin accuses Samantha of playing up to Monster. Samantha taunts him about Liza. However, when Monster winds up to clout Darrin, he bruises his hands on the invisible shield Samantha has created. When Liza slaps Darrin, however, Samantha lets him get the full force of the blow. Later Samantha removes her own protective shield when Darrin tries to make up.

programme.title: Witch Or Wife
programme.desc: Darrin's workload piles sky-high when Larry Tate and his wife Louise fly to Paris to cover the fashion showings- for a client. Samantha spends most of the time alone playing solitaire. She accepts Endora's invitation to fly to Paris, without a plane, of course, for lunch. In Paris, Samantha and Endora run into the Tates. Larry is surprised, phones Darrin that Samantha and her mother are in Paris with them. Samantha returns home immediately. Darrin tells Samantha their marriage is a mistake, since he has taken her away from all the high living she seems to love. Although Samantha tries to convinces Darrin that he is wrong, she angrily leaves, and returns to Paris. Larry Tate tells Darrin Samantha is lonesome for him. Darrin decides to follow her to Paris. After several unsuccessful tries, Samantha gets on Darrin's plane, and they arrive in Paris together.
